---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an enhancement or new capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

What the feature does and why it fits this offline reference project. Please keep requests within the existing scope: bounded retrieval, citations, portable install, privacy, routing, synthetic fixtures. I am not adding hosted services, telemetry, or marketing copy.

## Scope and impact

- Does it change user-facing instructions? Which docs?
- Does it affect offline use, portable install, or the citation server?
- Any new dependency, external service, or runtime network behavior?
- Security or privacy impact?

## Proposed approach

Brief outline; reference any existing issue, upstream project, or design doc (`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/VERIFICATION.md`).

## Alternative considered

Why not reuse existing behavior (e.g., synthetic fixtures, bounded retrieval, existing adapter, or manual download pipeline)?

## Source and rights

If this introduces copied material, a new dependency, or a derived asset: source, license, and attribution. Confirm it is compatible with GPL-3.0-only and does not impose additional restrictions.

## Search first

Confirm this is not already requested or in progress. Reference related issues. A focused request within the existing offline/reference boundary is much more likely to be considered.
